evals.name: large-nextjs-with-ai
evals.prompt: can you atlas the repo at ~/projects/milgapo? i've got a contractor starting next week and i want to hand him one thing that shows how the whole system fits together — the routes, the crons, where data actually lands, and especially the AI bits since that's what he'll be touching first
evals.expected_output: A .atlas/atlas.json plus rendered .atlas/atlas.html for the milgapo repo. Top-level overview of 15-30 nodes covering entry points, scheduled jobs, services, Postgres/stores, external integrations (resend, etc.) and the @ai-sdk/google AI layer with model and tool nodes. sourceRefs point at real files. Containers expand to the full route/schema/feature inventory. Agent reports file paths plus a short summary, does not echo the JSON.
assertions: [format] Produced a valid atlas.json in the v2 contract shape
[format] Passes render.py --check with no errors
[format] Passes render.py --check with ZERO warnings
[format] Top-level overview stays in the readable band
[format] Every edge endpoint is a real node id
[format] Uses drill-down containers rather than a flat overview
[format] Rendered a self-contained HTML with no external network refs
[substance] Surfaces the AI layer this repo actually has
[substance] Every source path it cites actually exists in the repo
[substance] Accounts for every third-party service in the dependency manifest
[substance] Reports back with paths and a summary, without echoing the raw data

evals.name: large-python-pipeline
evals.prompt: I need a visual of how scout actually works end to end — what kicks things off, the background jobs, and where data ends up. it's at ~/projects/scout and it's a big python repo so please don't try to read every file
evals.expected_output: An atlas for the scout repo built command-first (listings + greps + manifests, not file-by-file reads). Covers docker-compose services, schema.sql tables, cron/worker entry points, and the google-generativeai layer. Stays inside the node caps despite ~2k source files by merging near-identical items. Should NOT trigger a full file-by-file read of the repo.
